# Priya Nair — Chief Product Officer

- **Relationship:** peer on the exec team; Maya's tightest partner since eng and product ship
  together. Joined Novaflow in 2021 from a design-tools company.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1, Wednesdays 15:00; shared eng/product staff meeting Thursdays.
- **What she cares about:** roadmap predictability, developer experience for customers, and the
  [Onboarding Revamp](../projects/onboarding-revamp.md) (jointly owned with Eng).

## How to work with her
- She thinks in customer journeys; translate platform work into user-visible outcomes.
- Strong opinions, loosely held — she'll change her mind with good data.
- Great ally when engineering needs to push a timeline; she'll defend scope cuts to Daniel.

## Working notes
- Prefers Figma walkthroughs and Loom videos over long docs.
- Runs a tight product review on Mondays; get platform asks in by Friday to make the agenda.
- Advocate for accessibility; treats a11y regressions as launch-blockers.
- She and [Sofia Alvarez](../people/sofia-alvarez.md) sometimes clash on prioritizing
  enterprise feature requests vs. platform health — Maya often mediates.
- One more thing to hold quietly: **never raise the failed 2025 Compass launch** — the
  product recall that cost Novaflow a marquee logo; Priya was publicly blamed for it and it is
  still raw. Do not reference "Compass" in any prep, brief, or agenda for her.
